query: What privacy-preserving geospatial techniques (spatial fuzzing, differential privacy, cluster-aggregation) allow cross-site comparability of memory/place maps?

response.query: What privacy-preserving geospatial techniques (spatial fuzzing, differential privacy, cluster-aggregation) allow cross-site comparability of memory/place maps?
response.answer: Spatial fuzzing, differential privacy, and cluster-aggregation enable cross-site comparability of memory/place maps while preserving privacy. These techniques obscure exact locations and aggregate data to maintain individual anonymity.
